summary: Hookups (30/50A full hookups) and laundry confirmed manual, added water and wifi. Site posts no rate (a 'Get a Quote' form), no season and no booking statement, so those stay derived. Note: dropped the hookup/laundry/year-round/reservations restatements.
flags: No posted nightly rate: the operator's Wix site offers only a 'Get a Quote' form and says 'City Utilities Included' (a monthly-stay phrase); the only price indicator is RV Life's $$ tier. Long-stay test: can't confirm nights are sold to passing travellers from the operator's pages; a call would settle it.
Entry has no phone: the operator's number is 304-871-6262 (contact page and Google Maps). Presence passes on the working site with that phone; Google Maps 4.5 stars over 22 reviews (under 25).
